text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The final battle of the three-race series 
against Crimson Nova. With the Tokyo 
Daishoten just days away.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
The grand finale of this year... The 
impression this race leaves will likely 
have a huge impact on Funabashi's image.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Run well, and they'll see you in a new 
light. Run poorly, and nothing changes...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
“—We are challengers. We'll charge ahead 
without fear!”
choice_data_list:
Yeah, let's show them that Funabashi 
spirit!

Yeah, let's show them the Funabashi 
spirit!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I'm prepared to throw caution to the wind, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"Crimson Nova... I wonder how the JRA side 
feels about this."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"It seemed they held different feelings 
from ours, but..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Of course, I don't know exactly how things 
feel from their perspective, but...
choice_data_list: Shall we try to imagine it?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Imagine...? The feelings of those in the 
Central, you mean?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
...You're right. Reading the opponent's 
state of mind might also be a key to 
victory.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Imagine... the feelings of those in the 
Central...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
(Central Tracen Academy, where the 
nation's fiercest gather. The Umamusume 
who reigns at the very top of it all is, 
in other words—)

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
(――An overwhelmingly strong powerhouse! 
What goes through the mind of the strong 
as they run?)

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
(A sense of "omnipotence," "excitement," 
"euphoria"... or perhaps the "sheer 
pleasure" of trampling the weak...)

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: (Just what could they be sensing...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That night, as I was eating dinner and 
watching TV with Furioso...

text_block_list.name: TV Host
text_block_list.text:
Now then, with the Tokyo Daishoten fast 
approaching. For the Central side bracing 
for the regional challengers...

text_block_list.name: TV Host
text_block_list.text:
This is definitely a battle we cannot 
lose.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Furioso suddenly froze in her tracks at 
the sound of the voice coming from the 
TV."

text_block_list.name: TV Color Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Yes, the difference in race records 
between the Central and Regional circuits 
is clear as day.

text_block_list.name: TV Color Commentator
text_block_list.text:
I hope she wins decisively here and shows 
the true strength of the Central.

text_block_list.name: TV Host
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Her stable is undoubtedly 
preparing for a certain victory.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"Certain victory... A battle I cannot 
afford to lose..."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"The opposite stance from ours... In other 
words..."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: ...I see. Maybe...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Furioso nodded slightly—

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Trainer... I think I might have an idea.
choice_data_list: How does the Central side feel about it?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Listening to what the media was 
saying just now, I just kind of felt it.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"If we win, it's a huge upset. Even if we 
lose, we have nothing to lose."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
On the other hand, their side is expected 
to win by default. And if they lose, 
they'll face harsh criticism.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"A champion is bold, a champion is 
composed. That's how I thought it went, 
but..."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Perhaps it's surprisingly not the case.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Furioso and I also began to vaguely 
understand the position the URA was in.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Winning is taken for granted. If that's 
how everyone's always looked at them, the 
URA side must be feeling...

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And now, the Tokyo Daishoten. Crimson Nova 
makes her grand entrance today as well.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
As calm and composed as ever. Now that is 
the true dignity of a champion!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
She simply keeps her eyes closed, paying 
no mind to her surroundings.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: (No... Maybe...)

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
(It's not that they don't care about their 
surroundings. More likely...)

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
(The URA side doesn't have the luxury to 
care about what's around them.)

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
(—Certain victory, ever-triumphant, the 
absolute sun. Winning is a given; defeat 
is unthinkable.)

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
(If they lose, it won't just hurt 
themselves; the prestige of the Central 
itself will be tarnished.)

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
(If she runs carrying that kind of 
pressure every single time...)

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: There's no way... I can just stay quiet...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
The one standing there... isn't some 
arrogant champion...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
A solitary champion, standing tall with 
immense responsibility on their shoulders. 
If so, then I—

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
With what mindset should I run? With what 
feeling should I take on this 
challenge...?

text_block_list.name: Funabashi Umamusume Samin
text_block_list.text:
Go get 'em! Show 'em what you've got, 
Furi-chan!!

text_block_list.name: Funabashi Umamusume Myu
text_block_list.text:
That's right! We're not just going to sit 
back and take a beating anymore~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Furioso in pursuit of Central. Her 
breakthroughs reinvigorate the Funabashi 
contingent as well.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Standing beside them as an equal is no 
longer just a dream, but...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
I can't... sort out my feelings in time. 
Even so—

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"I have to do this! If it's tough on them 
too, there's bound to be an opening. 
...There has to be!"
